DT=2026-11-13
# provenance today
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
TZ = timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
day = "2026-11-13"
paths = [
  "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/data/task_provenance.jsonl",
  os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state/youchu_ai_inbox.jsonl"),
  "/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/omdb/tgbot/incoming/worker_ant_agent_bus_inbox.jsonl",
]
for p in paths:
  print("===", p, "exists=", os.path.exists(p))
  if not os.path.exists(p):
    continue
  n=0
  with open(p, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
    for line in f:
      line=line.strip()
      if not line: continue
      try:
        o=json.loads(line)
      except Exception:
        continue
      # find time fields
      ts = o.get("ts") or o.get("time") or o.get("created_at") or o.get("received_at") or o.get("timestamp") or ""
      if isinstance(ts, (int,float)):
        try:
          ts = datetime.fromtimestamp(ts/1000 if ts>1e12 else ts, TZ).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        except Exception:
          ts=str(ts)
      else:
        ts=str(ts)
      if day not in ts and day.replace("-","") not in ts:
        # also check nested
        blob=json.dumps(o, ensure_ascii=False)[:500]
        if day not in blob:
          continue
      n+=1
      src=o.get("source") or o.get("kind") or o.get("channel") or ""
      text=(o.get("text") or o.get("summary") or o.get("body") or o.get("prompt") or o.get("message") or "")
      if isinstance(text, dict):
        text=str(text)
      text=str(text).replace("\n"," ")[:220]
      bus=o.get("bus_id") or o.get("id") or o.get("reply_to_bus_id") or ""
      print(f"- ts={ts} src={src} bus={bus} | {text}")
      if n>=40:
        print("...(cap 40)")
        break
  print("matched", n)
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, glob
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
TZ = timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
day = "2026-11-13"
state = os.path.expanduser("~/Library/Application Support/youchu-agent-bus/state")
# list jsonl
for p in sorted(glob.glob(state+"/*.jsonl"))+sorted(glob.glob(state+"/*.json")):
  try:
    sz=os.path.getsize(p)
  except: continue
  if sz>50_000_000: 
    print("skip huge", p, sz); continue
  hits=[]
  try:
    with open(p,"r",encoding="utf-8",errors="replace") as f:
      if p.endswith(".json") and not p.endswith(".jsonl"):
        try:
          data=json.load(f)
          items=data if isinstance(data,list) else [data]
        except Exception:
          continue
      else:
        items=[]
        for line in f:
          line=line.strip()
          if not line: continue
          try: items.append(json.loads(line))
          except: pass
  except Exception as e:
    print("err",p,e); continue
  for o in items:
    blob=json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False)
    if day not in blob and "2026-11-13" not in blob: continue
    # prefer outbound from youchu
    text=(o.get("text") or o.get("body") or o.get("message") or o.get("prompt") or "")
    if isinstance(text,dict): text=str(text)
    text=str(text).replace("\n"," ")[:180]
    kind=o.get("kind") or o.get("type") or o.get("direction") or ""
    bus=o.get("bus_id") or o.get("reply_to_bus_id") or o.get("id") or ""
    to=o.get("to") or o.get("recipient") or ""
    fr=o.get("from") or o.get("sender") or ""
    ts=o.get("ts") or o.get("time") or o.get("created_at") or ""
    hits.append((str(ts)[:19], kind, fr, to, bus, text))
  if hits:
    print("===", os.path.basename(p), "hits", len(hits))
    for h in hits[:25]:
      print("-", h)
PY

# Summarize each today's transcript: first user msg + last assistant conclusions
TRANS="/Users/mac/.cursor/projects/Users-mac-Desktop-CHcode/agent-transcripts"
for id in 1e7a798c-af62-48f2-ba8b-e0aeaf276514 dad822c5-73d0-4a0f-933e-01afb4b46077 ddecb19e-39ea-4e77-9315-023b9dde380c 0e088fad-a37f-4ddb-80a4-b84a55f38ceb ead90159-6db6-4bd8-8c5c-9ee52dd9dd99 15c989eb-93f7-46b1-ba05-ad02bb60ad17 0f79142d-ab53-4e17-9803-8a03830a293f; do
  f="$TRANS/$id/$id.jsonl"
  echo "======== $id ========"
  python3 - <<PY
import json
path="$f"
users=[]; assts=[]
with open(path,encoding="utf-8") as f:
  for line in f:
    try: o=json.loads(line)
    except: continue
    role=o.get("role") or (o.get("message") or {}).get("role") or o.get("type")
    # cursor transcript formats vary
    content=o.get("content") or o.get("text") or ""
    msg=o.get("message") or {}
    if isinstance(msg, dict):
      role=role or msg.get("role")
      c=msg.get("content")
      if isinstance(c, list):
        parts=[]
        for p in c:
          if isinstance(p, dict) and p.get("type")=="text":
            parts.append(p.get("text",""))
          elif isinstance(p,str): parts.append(p)
        content=content or "\n".join(parts)
      elif isinstance(c,str):
        content=content or c
    if not content: continue
    content=str(content)
    if role in ("user","human") or o.get("type")=="user":
      users.append(content[:400])
    elif role in ("assistant","ai") or o.get("type")=="assistant":
      assts.append(content[:500])
print("USER0:", (users[0] if users else "")[:350].replace("\n"," "))
if len(users)>1:
  print("USER_last:", users[-1][:350].replace("\n"," "))
print("ASST_last:", (assts[-1] if assts else "")[:450].replace("\n"," "))
print("n_user",len(users),"n_asst",len(assts))
PY
done
